newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher, Telefonica shines.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher, Telefonica shines.

text.p: The Madrid bourse ended stronger on Monday, setting yet another all-time record, with Spain's most-capitalised stock, Telefonica, leading the charge.
The General index closed up 2.36 points, or 0.38 percent, at 628.15. The Ibex-35 advanced 30.24 points, or 0.42 percent, at 7,204.54 points.
Telefonica outpaced overall gains, rising 115 points or 2.53 percent to 4,665 pesetas, although dealers said there was no specific news and that investors were simply after blue chips.
"It seems that people are looking for top notch paper," a dealer said.
Radiotronica put in the worst performance of the day, dropping 15 percent as trading suspension cancelled following news it would cut 652 jobs amid slumping sales.
Dealers said they see the overall market continuing to climb as long as friendly conditions prevail at other markets.
"We closed in the middle of resistance, but the market is firm and if other centres rise too, we can go on climbing," a dealer at a foreign brokerage said.
